notes: This focused trace covers the pinned IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.4.1 prohibition on RTI ownership transfer of MOM instance attributes and a bounded §11.2.1 observation that the RTI retains ownership of one predefined HLAfederate attribute. The portable C++ TCK queries ownership before and after acquisition-if-available and negotiated acquisition, checks for no acquisition notification or release request, and requires attributeIsOwnedByRTI on every query. It does not require a particular exception response, establish indefinite retention for every MOM attribute, or claim conformance.

requirements.source_symbol: RTI ownership transfer of MOM instance attributes
requirements.statement: An RTI shall never engage in ownership transfer of MOM instance attributes.
tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_joined_federate_mom_public_object_lifecycle_catch2.cpp::Embedded joined-federate MOM objects use the public discovery reflection and removal route

requirements.statement: The portable public C++ TCK observes the predefined HLAfederateName attribute on one RTI-registered HLAfederate MOM instance as RTI-owned before and after both ownership-acquisition attempts. This is bounded evidence that the RTI does not divest that attribute during the exercised interval, not proof of indefinite retention for all MOM attributes.
